summary.idConvention: Deterministic application IDs; not official Lensware record IDs.
summary.indexOrigin: Nominal label extracted from Descr; 1.6 is displayed as 1.60.
summary.thicknessMeaning: Raw blank CT/ET from source, not finished-lens thickness.
summary.rangeBoundaryAssumption: Inclusive; validate against Lensware before production use.
summary.zeroCylinderAssumption: Literal zero for candidate search; wildcard semantics not confirmed.
summary.selectionPriority: Not supplied. Return all matching candidates; do not auto-pick lowest CT.

units.dimensions: Source CSV omits units; mm assumed for display, to be verified by lab.
units.baseCurve: Source convention; nominal/true curve reference not supplied.
